actions.action: Check stems and roots for rot (soft, black, mushy, sour smell)
Bottom-soak pot in water 20-30 minutes, drain completely, empty saucer
Trim fully yellow, brown or crispy leaves at the base
Move plant to bright indirect light away from drafts and heaters
Water when top few centimetres of soil are dry, ensuring free drainage
